hero.eyebrow: Between two sides, a space where ideas are born
hero.titleAccent: so you can build the future.
hero.lead: Bayn turns a spark of an idea into a shipped project. Post what you're building, find the right collaborators, run everything from one dashboard, and keep a record of every decision along the way.

mock.milestoneMeta: A new member joined the team

features.title: From first idea to shipped project
features.lead: Bayn brings the marketplace, the team, and the workflow together, so nothing gets lost between the idea and the build.
features.marketplaceDesc: Publish your idea or browse a live feed of projects looking for builders. Filter by skills, stage, and category to find your next thing.
features.teamDesc: Send and review join requests, match by required skills, and assemble the exact team your project needs, no cold DMs required.
features.dashboardDesc: Track progress, milestones, and members at a glance. Every task and update lives in one clean, shared view of the build.
features.meetingsDesc: Schedule meetings, keep shared notes, and turn conversations into action items, all attached to the project they belong to.
features.aiDesc: Smart recommendations connect your idea with the collaborators most likely to make it real, based on skills and interests.
features.profilesDesc: A profile that shows what you can do, skills, past projects, and roles, so the right teams can find you and trust your work.

how.title: Four steps to your next build
how.lead: The same simple flow whether you're bringing an idea or joining one.
how.step1Desc: Add your skills, interests, and what you're looking to build. This is how teams discover you.
how.step2Desc: Share your idea to the marketplace, or browse projects that need exactly what you bring.
how.step3Desc: Approve join requests, form your team, and kick off the project dashboard together.
how.step4Desc: Run milestones and meetings while Bayn records every step of how you got there.

market.title: Discover ideas worth building
market.lead: A living feed of real projects and the people behind them. Every card tells you the stage, the skills needed, and who's already on board.
market.point1: Filter by skills, category, and project stage
market.point2: See required roles before you request to join
market.point3: One click to send a join request
market.idea1Desc: A smart assistant that helps users budget, save, and plan, built around real spending data.
market.idea2Desc: Connecting local drivers and small shops with a shared delivery network.
market.idea3Desc: An app that makes learning Arabic feel like a conversation, not a textbook.

dash.title: Run the whole project from one screen
dash.lead: Milestones, tasks, members, and meetings, organized and shared. Bayn keeps a documented trail so anyone can catch up on how the project got here.
dash.point1: Progress tracking with milestones and tasks
dash.point2: Meetings with shared notes and action items
dash.point3: A documented history of every decision

quote.text: I came to Bayn with just an idea and no team. Three weeks later I had four collaborators, a working prototype, and a record of every step we took to get there.
quote.name: Assaf Al-saeed
